description: Ministry of Education - Order under Section 27(1), Department of Information and Communication Technology Eastern University Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the amendment of a university's academic structure (adding a Department of Information and Communication Technology) under the Universities Act. While it mentions a Minister by name, it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed ministerial portfolio responsibilities. The content specifically relates to higher education administration, which falls under the Miscellaneous category (Type 10) for educational matters and academic appointments not covered by the other specialized types.
